content: In this paper we report experiments on the EBM-NLP corpus comprising crowdsourced annotations of medical literature BIBREF5 . We operationalize the concept of annotation difficulty and show how it can be exploited during training to improve information extraction models. We then obtain expert annotations for the abstracts predicted to be most difficult, as well as for a similar number of randomly selected abstracts. The annotation of highly specialized data and the use of lay and expert annotators allow us to examine the following key questions related to lay and expert annotations in specialized domains:
